grade_reason: Six web searches and a check of his campaign platform found no statement by Jim Kingston about AI since 1 January 2025, and none about catastrophic AI risk.
notes: All 6 searches ran; none was refused. This is his first run for office (son of former Rep. Jack Kingston), so there is no earlier official record and he could not have co-sponsored the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act or signed the House letters. Opened his campaign site jimkingston.org and its /issues platform page (16 issue headings): no mention of AI, data centers or technology beyond 'technological superiority' for the military; China is mentioned only as an adversary and for manufacturing dependence. Opened a WTOC 29 October 2026 article on his priorities: no mention of AI. Search results for AI statements turned up other Georgia officials (e.g. Rep. Rich McCormick, state legislators), not him. His iVoterGuide questionnaire was described in search results as covering abortion-related issues only; not opened. Search was not exhaustive for local debates or interviews.
